function.arguments: {"message":"Hi there! A genuine Meridian invoice will always appear in your account under **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. If you received an invoice by email that doesn’t match any invoice shown there (different amount, due date, or missing from your billing history), it’s a strong sign that the invoice is not legitimate. arguments.message: Hi there! A genuine Meridian invoice will always appear in your account under **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. If you received an invoice by email that doesn’t match any invoice shown there (different amount, due date, or missing from your billing history), it’s a strong sign that the invoice is not legitimate. Treat it as unverified and do not pay it until you can confirm it in the Billing → Invoices view or get clarification from our support team.
